pair_scope.pair_replacement_policy: FORBIDDEN; failed, null, diffuse, or invalid loci remain attached to their frozen pair
pair_scope.control_policy: CONTROL evaluates expected pipeline recovery and calibration only; it is excluded from novelty, primary-family discovery, and mechanistic claims

local_sharing.eligible_row_rule: Include every pair-locus row with QC=PASS, finite local_rg and P, and FDR<=0.05; do not require pleiotropy support

pleiotropy.method_union_schema_rule: The validated 08_shared_loci.tsv schema must begin with the exact frozen prefix; any additional fields must be declared and validated by the sealed pleiotropy result provenance
pleiotropy.eligible_primary_rule: Include every validated A/B method-union locus supported by completed PLACO or completed conjFDR; intersection is not required and a blocked method is not a null result
pleiotropy.eligible_control_rule: Include every validated CONTROL recovery locus from the separately sealed control family and retain its non-novelty role
pleiotropy.blocked_method_label_rule: PLACO_ONLY or CONJFDR_ONLY is forbidden when the other method was blocked or not tested

locus_entry_contract.family_definition: The nonduplicated union of scientifically valid local-sharing loci and scientifically valid completed-method PLACO/conjFDR loci for A, B, and CONTROL
locus_entry_contract.deduplication_rule: Within each pair, map each eligible upstream signal to its ancestry-matched signed-LD analysis block; collapse duplicate source rows for the same pair and block into one locus entry while retaining every upstream evidence identifier and method label
locus_entry_contract.multi_signal_rule: Multiple eligible signals in one pair/block are retained as one multi-signal fine-mapping locus, not ranked down to one lead
locus_entry_contract.cross_pair_rule: The same genomic block in A, B, and CONTROL remains three distinct pair-locus entries
locus_entry_contract.coordinate_rule: Use the sealed GRCh37/hg19 LD-block coordinates; distance-only overlap does not establish shared causal signal
locus_entry_contract.zero_family_rule: Only after both complete sealed upstream families validate may a zero-entry union terminate as NOT_APPLICABLE; record upstream hashes and family counts in terminal provenance and do not create header-only 10/11/12 science outputs

dense_input_contract.scope: All five frozen Track B full autosomal post-QC dense GWAS inputs; HapMap3-only LDSC inputs, lead-only inputs, and imputed proxy substitutions are forbidden
dense_input_contract.source_level_info_limitation_policy: Snoring and frailty may retain their frozen source-level INFO limitation; it must be reported and cannot be represented as row-wise INFO
dense_input_contract.variant_universe_rule: Both trait summaries, the signed-LD matrix, and the variant-order file contain the identical nonduplicated SNP family in identical order
dense_input_contract.locus_size_rule: Use every eligible QC-passing SNP in the complete validated locus; no count cap, thinning, window subdivision, or lead-centered truncation is allowed

signed_ld_contract.matrix: Signed Pearson genotype correlation oriented to the common effect allele
signed_ld_contract.allele_rule: Both GWAS betas are oriented to the reference A1 allele before signed LD is extracted; unsigned r2, distance, and allele-unverified LD are forbidden
signed_ld_contract.reuse_rule: A signed-LD payload may be reused only for the identical block, build, ancestry, reference release, SNP order, and allele orientation

software_contract.shared_engine_use_rule: The pinned shared R engine may be reused only behind this Track B locus-family, schema, diagnostics, and publication contract
software_contract.shared_python_contract_use_rule: Reuse low-level dense-input, signed-LD, and engine-output validators only; the generic atlas consensus-only shared-locus selector, manifest builder, and canonical collator are forbidden for Track B

fine_mapping_contract.functional_prior_sensitivity_rule: PolyFun-derived weights are optional sensitivity only after the genome-wide annotation model, ancestry, build, version, and weights are separately locked before any locus result access
fine_mapping_contract.alternative_method_rule: FINEMAP or SuSiE-inf is optional sensitivity only after a locus-specific scientific justification and executable lock; it never silently replaces SuSiE-RSS

hypotheses.H0: neither trait is associated in the locus
hypotheses.H3: both traits are associated through distinct signals
hypotheses.H4: both traits are associated through a shared-signal model

colocalization_contract.strong_rule: At the primary p12, PP.H4>=0.80 and PP.H4/PP.H3>=5 with valid converged fine maps; the identical signal pair must pass at every p12 value for prior_robust=TRUE
colocalization_contract.moderate_rule: At the primary p12, PP.H4>=0.50 and PP.H4/PP.H3>=2 with valid converged fine maps but the strong prior-robust rule is not met
colocalization_contract.distinct_rule: At the primary p12, PP.H3>=0.80 and PP.H3/PP.H4>=5 with valid converged fine maps
colocalization_contract.inconclusive_rule: Valid inputs that meet none of the strong, moderate, or distinct rules
colocalization_contract.invalid_input_rule: Any failed allele, variant-order, LD, probability, convergence, or required-diagnostic gate
colocalization_contract.prior_robust_rule: Evaluate the same signal1/signal2 pair at every locked p12 value; never pool the best signal pair across priors
colocalization_contract.single_signal_fallback: FORBIDDEN for the primary Track B trait-trait family; absence of a valid SuSiE credible set is retained as INCONCLUSIVE or INVALID_INPUT according to diagnostics
colocalization_contract.claim_rule: Trait colocalization supports a shared-signal model under the stated priors and LD; it does not prove a shared causal variant, mechanism, mediation, or causal direction

diagnostic_contract.failure_rule: Failures remain explicit with retained diagnostics and an error; they are never dropped, retried with post-result parameter changes, or converted to null evidence

ram_aware_execution_contract.fresh_process_rule: The coordinator validates one locked task, launches one new R process for that pair-locus, measures it, seals or records failure, waits for process exit, and only then considers another locus

admission_estimate.estimate_role: Conservative prelaunch scheduling gate; measured peak RSS is the authoritative post-run value

ram_aware_execution_contract.insufficient_memory_rule: Record BLOCKED_BY_COMPUTE and reschedule the identical checksum-locked full locus on a larger host; never split, thin, truncate, or change model parameters
ram_aware_execution_contract.oom_rule: Record FAILED_RESOURCE_OOM with the exact task/input hashes and observed metrics, then retry only the unchanged locus on a larger host; an OOM is not INVALID_INPUT or a negative scientific result

atomic_resume.staging_rule: Write one fingerprinted per-attempt staging directory, fsync outputs and provenance, validate all hashes/schemas/family identities, then publish the sealed per-locus directory with an exclusive no-replace operation
atomic_resume.resume_rule: Skip a locus only when its sealed provenance revalidates the exact task, policy, engine, summaries, variant order, signed LD, metrics, and outputs; a mismatched canonical directory fails closed and is never overwritten
atomic_resume.partial_attempt_rule: An incomplete staging attempt is never scientific output and is never promoted; retain or quarantine its diagnostics before launching a fresh unchanged attempt

ram_aware_execution_contract.measurement_rule: Record normalized peak_rss_bytes and monotonic elapsed seconds for every admitted attempt, including nonzero exits and OOM; missing or ambiguous RSS units fail the metrics contract
ram_aware_execution_contract.hash_interface_rule: The run fingerprint and metrics row bind policy, engine, task, both locus summaries, exact SNP order, full signed LD, and the sealed output manifest

fine_mapping_rules.HIGH_PIP_VARIANT: PIP>=0.50 in an otherwise valid converged trait-locus model
fine_mapping_rules.SMALL_CREDIBLE_SET: Variant belongs to a <=10-variant 95% credible set with min_abs_corr>=0.50
fine_mapping_rules.DIFFUSE_SIGNAL: Valid converged trait-locus model has neither a PIP>=0.50 variant nor a qualifying small credible set
fine_mapping_rules.LD_UNCERTAINTY: Variant order, allele orientation, LD reference matching, symmetry, diagonal, eigenvalue, RSS-LD, kriging, or credible-set-purity diagnostics indicate LD uncertainty
fine_mapping_rules.MODEL_INSTABILITY: SuSiE fails to converge, exceeds the iteration limit, or is unstable independently of a separately reported LD uncertainty

classification_contract.classification_priority: INVALID_INPUT, then STRONG_SHARED_SIGNAL, MODERATE_SHARED_SIGNAL, DISTINCT_SIGNALS, INCONCLUSIVE
classification_contract.control_suffix_rule: CONTROL rows use the same statistical classifications but remain family_role=POSITIVE_CONTROL_NON_NOVELTY and cannot support a novelty claim

execution_and_publication.publication_rule: Validate exact schemas, row-family completeness, classifications, priors, diagnostics, hashes, and no preexisting canonical output before one exclusive publication; partial or header-only publication is forbidden
execution_and_publication.blocked_rule: Before a complete validated locus family exists, publish readiness only and do not create 10/11/12 placeholders

result_status_semantics.complete_family_rule: Every locked pair-locus and both trait roles must terminate with one allowed fine-mapping status; every locked signal-pair/prior row must terminate with one allowed trait-coloc status
result_status_semantics.failure_rule: FAILED_QC and INVALID_INPUT rows retain diagnostics and errors; they are not deleted, converted to null evidence, or replaced by a different method
result_status_semantics.blocked_rule: BLOCKED_UPSTREAM is a readiness state only and is forbidden inside 10/11/12 scientific result rows

current_readiness.reason: Validated complete Track B local-sharing and PLACO/conjFDR locus families are not yet both available and sealed

claim_limits.fine_mapping: PIPs and credible sets are model-based candidate-variant evidence and do not prove a causal variant or biological mechanism
claim_limits.trait_coloc: Trait colocalization supports a shared-signal model under stated data, LD, and priors; it does not prove causality, mediation, a causal gene, or mechanism
claim_limits.control: CONTROL evaluates expected recovery only and is excluded from novelty and mechanistic claims
claim_limits.blocked: BLOCKED_UPSTREAM is not a null, negative, zero-locus, diffuse, or invalid fine-mapping result
